name: il-court-docs
description: Illinois court documents plugin. Cook County Circuit Court (Law & Chancery Divisions), DuPage and Lake Circuit Courts, county-courts roll-up, family court, and small-claims. Six subject-matter bundles: consumer-debt (ICFA), family-law (IMFL 750 ILCS 5), landlord-tenant (Chicago RLTO + RLTA), personal-injury (modified comparative fault 51%), employment (IHRA/IDHR exhaustion + IWPCA), and commercial-disputes (Illinois UCC + IUAA). eFileIL mandatory e-filing. Full detail in the plugin README.
